Recovered abandoned worker lane from /Users/rollacode/Developer/codeterm-agent-message (pane 66291019 was closed). Integrated the diff into the feat/canvas checkout.

Changes:
- Added `codeterm agent message --pane <id> [text|--from-file|--stdin]` as an immediate running-agent message command.
- Routed it through the existing send transport (`/api/panes/<id>/send`) for local and mesh CLI paths.
- Updated CLI manifest/docs/skills prompt.

Orchestrator gates run in /Users/rollacode/Developer/codeterm:
- `cargo test --manifest-path cli/Cargo.toml agent_message -- --nocapture` -> 3 passed.
- `cargo test --manifest-path cli/Cargo.toml message_parses_text_and_target_pane -- --nocapture` -> 1 passed.
- `cargo test --manifest-path cli/Cargo.toml message_requires_target_pane -- --nocapture` -> 2 passed.
- `git diff --check` -> passed.

Functional smoke was not run against this pane to avoid injecting a recursive user turn into the orchestrator; parser + API mapping prove the command uses the same send transport.
